implementation_notes: Each user hook has one default owner within its matching USER marker region.
Fixed and user signals combine only in aggregate scaffold logic outside markers.
CHECK, ISSUE/PC advance, END/error drain, acquire/release and error paths consume aggregate signals.
No fixed GEMM or other user-executor ports were added to the base template.
remaining_risks: Each generated user extension still requires fresh design-specific simulation, lint and synthesis evidence.
The probe demonstrates one single-pending two-bank user executor; richer executors must implement their own bounded pending identity structure inside USER regions.
The retained Verilator 4.038 cannot lint timing-control testbenches; those testbenches were executed with XSIM 2025.2, while both base and generated RTL passed Verilator lint.
OOC timing excludes placed/routed and board-boundary behavior.
No data memory, DMA payload datapath, board wrapper, bitstream or hardware behavior is claimed.
